text:
alex: Hi team — PR #8734 is ready but I'm gating on architecture signoff + RFC link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8734 RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/1792. Looking to merge Thu EOD if we get ack.

morgan: quick q — what's the expected p95 delta? need a number for SLO impact.

alex: Ran a microbench: p50 ~unchanged, p95 +7ms on avg for 2048 seq. Throughput similar. Pasted bench snippet below.
```
Benchmark: 1000 reqs
baseline p95: 42ms
this PR p95: 49ms
error rate: 0.0%
```

sara: Thanks. Can you add the SLO delta to PR description and a short note about cost impact? Also cc @jamal for infra/routing effects.

jamal: Skimmed the diff. Main concern is KV cache invalidation during rollout + TTL behavior. Need a canary plan + runbook steps. Also: is there a compatible fallback model variant if routing fails?

alex: Good call — plan to canary 10% traffic for 2h, monitor latency + error rate, and automatic rollback if error rate > 1% OR latency regression > 20% vs baseline. Fallback: we will route to model-v1 (current GA) if new route fails. I'll add runbook and canary config to the PR.

morgan: :thumbsup: please also add the RFC id and a short sentence linking design rationale into the PR body. Label the PR with `rfc:1792` and `arch-review`.

alex: Done — PR body now contains RFC summary, SLO numbers, and labels. Added a changelog entry.

design-bot: Automated check: PR body contains RFC link and labels. 1/3 required checks passed.

sara: LGTM pending jamal's runbook details. Two small nits: shorten feature-flag TTL to 30s and add metrics prefix `inf.runtime.`

jamal: Left a comment with runbook steps, rollback commands, and Prometheus alerts to watch (`inf.runtime.latency.p95`, `inf.runtime.errors.rate`). After that I can approve.

alex: Pushed runbook update and set TTL to 30s. Added metrics to Prometheus scrape. Comments addressed. Removing hold if canary passes.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-11-12T18:00:00Z — 10% for 2h. Monitoring: infra dashboards + alerting.

jamal: ACK — I'll watch the rollout window and confirm post-canary. If alerts fire, we'll roll back per runbook.

sara: Thanks everyone. Alex, once jamal approves can you request final arch-ack in PR so we can merge before Thu EOD?

alex: Yep — pinging for final arch ack.

morgan: One last ask — add a one-line note in PR about how this interacts with Dedicated capacity (capacity-based routing).
